name: @payswap/onchain-adapters
description: Multi-chain adapter SDK (Work Order P4-W2-001): EVM, Solana and UTXO chain-family adapters implementing the explicit adapter lifecycle (observe → prepare → simulate → authorize → broadcast → observe → finality → reconcile → evidence) behind the provider-neutral onchain-domain contracts, feeding the onchain-security kernel; vendor shapes (JSON-RPC providers, explorer APIs) live behind injected transport ports — no vendor SDK is a dependency
